title: Renaming the rerun workflows requires updating three different identifier forms
answers: renamed rerun workflow, what else must change
protect ignores wrong workflow after rename
retry reruns wrong workflows after rename
which files reference rerun workflow names
body:
Invariant: the rerun workflows are referenced by three different identifier forms that must all be updated together: the repo-relative path in Protect's IGNORED_WORKFLOWS set, the resourcePath suffix (endswith) in retry.sh's jq rerun flag, and the workflow display name in rerun.yml's workflow_run.workflows.
Enforcement: .github/workflows/protect.js:module.exports (IGNORED_WORKFLOWS = new Set([".github/workflows/trigger-rerun.yml"])), .github/workflows/retry.sh:runs (rerun: resourcePath endswith "/rerun.yml" or "/retry.yml" | not), .github/workflows/rerun.yml:on.
What breaks: a stale path in IGNORED_WORKFLOWS lets the approval trigger run be treated as a checks source; a stale endswith in retry.sh marks the worker as a normal retry target or misses it; stale names break the workflow_run chain. None of these fail loudly.
Applies: renames of .github/workflows/rerun.yml or trigger-rerun.yml; the three forms are not interchangeable, so do not copy one form into another location.
applies: Renames of .github/workflows/rerun.yml or trigger-rerun.yml and any edit to the workflow references in protect.js or retry.sh.
